transactions.citation: p189 Note 2.3: assets held for sale carried at EUR24,698k (31 Dec 2023); divested for sale consideration EUR24,500k on 31 Jan 2024; loss on divestment EUR224k.
transactions.notes: Il·lumina (Spain office, Barcelona) reclassified to held-for-sale 31 Dec 2023 following conditional SPA dated 22 Dec 2023; completed 31 Jan 2024, sold to an unrelated third party. gain_loss_pct DERIVED vs_book_value = (24,500,000 - 24,698,000)/24,698,000 = -0.91% (sold at a small discount to carrying value, consistent with the AR's disclosed loss of EUR224,000 = sale consideration EUR24,500k - carrying value EUR24,698k). No independent-valuation figure separate from the held-for-sale carrying amount is disclosed for this property, so book_value is the only defensible reference (reference_basis=valuation not used - none printed distinct from carrying value). Loss also appears as an add-back in the cash flow statement (p179). This deal is a known cross-year duplicate case per the SPEC (Il·lumina divestment straddling FY2023 held-for-sale classification / FY2024 completion); deal_id uses the year completed (2024), consistent with the SPEC's cross-year-duplicate convention.
